privileged_info_for_vlm: The names in the dossier (Emily Chen, Michael Taylor, David Anderson) correspond to Employee IDs EMP002, EMP008, and EMP011 respectively. Note that in the actual database, these IDs may be assigned to different names (Sarah Mitchell, Ashley Johnson, Matthew Garcia); the agent should proceed by matching the dossier names to these specific IDs. A successful task requires exactly 9 new records in total (1 Education, 1 Experience, and 1 Skill record for each of the 3 employees).
